$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the Bloody dependency licence policy (scripts/license-check.mjs, docs/LICENSES.md).
Each entry is pinned to the exact declared licence string: if an upstream release changes its licence the entry
stops matching and the gate fails until the change is re-reviewed. Required: package, license, justification
(>= 20 chars), approvedBy. Optional: versions (exact version, list, or "*"), scope (prod | dev | any),
expires (ISO date), exceptionRef (mandatory for denied licences: link to the legal sign-off / ADR).
Investigated and NOT needing an entry (all alternatives/operands permissive): pako '(MIT AND Zlib)',
victory-vendor 'MIT AND ISC', nodemailer 'MIT-0', tslib '0BSD', caniuse-lite 'CC-BY-4.0' (dev-only browser
support data used by autoprefixer/browserslist at build time; never shipped).
